evidence.eventual_fix_title: fix(deckgl): use DatasourceType enum in polygon transformProps test + some TS issues
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement: fix(deckgl): use DatasourceType enum in polygon transformProps test + some TS issues ### SUMMARY Fixes TypeScript error in the Polygon transformProps test introduced in [#35266](https://github.com/apache/superset/pull/35266) The test was using `'table' as const` for the datasource type, which TypeScript doesn't recognize as assignable to the `DatasourceType` enum. This PR: - Imports `DatasourceType` from `@superset-ui/core` - Uses `DatasourceType.Table` instead of the string literal - Adds required `Datasource` interface properties (`name`, `columns`, `metrics`)
